source.name: Utah Division of Wildlife Resources — 2025 Draw 5, Big Game Bonus Point Draw Results

notes: DWR 2025 limited-entry, premium limited-entry, CWMU and once-in-a-lifetime draw (https://wildlife.utah.gov/pdf/bg/2025/25_bg-odds.pdf). Utah's bonus-point draw: half of each hunt's permits go to the applicants with the most bonus points, the rest by random draw with one entry plus one per bonus point. pointLines per residency and bonus-point level: applicants = DWR "Eligible Applicants", drawn = "Total # Permits", bonus = "Bonus # Permits" (from the top-points pool); drawn − bonus = permits from the random pool. Every hunt's columns were checked against DWR's Totals row. DrawStat: tags = total permits issued to that residency, applicants = eligible applicants, successPct = tags ÷ applicants × 100 (computed here), minPoints = fewest points that drew any permit (bonus or random) — the random pool means it is not a cutoff. pools = permits from the bonus pool and the random pool. Weapon: Any Legal Weapon → rifle; Archery; Muzzleloader; H.A.M.S.S. (handgun, archery, muzzleloader, shotgun) left unset. CWMU hunts are on private cooperative wildlife management units and are labeled. Not included: bison and mountain goat; general-season deer (a separate preference-point draw); antlerless and youth draws.
